verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a RESTful API and a CLI with stable exit codes and a self-describing contract. Nothing in the evidence mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. The axis applies to a cloud platform with a public API, so the lack of evidence makes this "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
